g.text: PA9: GPIO VBUS detect; enable USB only with VBUS.

g.desc: PA9: GPIO VBUS detect; enable USB only with VBUS.

g.text: Internal D+ pull-up / termination. 90-ohm differential PCB pair.

g.desc: Internal D+ pull-up / termination. 90-ohm differential PCB pair.

g.text: TERM: POPULATE AT BUS ENDS ONLY

g.desc: TERM: POPULATE AT BUS ENDS ONLY

g.text: VM and +3V3_D supplied by power circuitry outside this specification.

g.desc: VM and +3V3_D supplied by power circuitry outside this specification.

g.text: VM capacitors: C15 bulk 220uF/63V; C16 at VMA; C17 at VMB; C18 10uF/50V.

g.desc: VM capacitors: C15 bulk 220uF/63V; C16 at VMA; C17 at VMB; C18 10uF/50V.

g.text: Keep VM-PGND loops short; paired pins joined at IC on PCB.

g.desc: Keep VM-PGND loops short; paired pins joined at IC on PCB.

g.text: NT1: single PGND-GND copper connection directly beneath IC2 exposed pad.

g.desc: NT1: single PGND-GND copper connection directly beneath IC2 exposed pad.

g.text: EP/corner pads to GND, dense thermal vias; 4 layers / 2oz. Motor outputs: 5A routing.

g.desc: EP/corner pads to GND, dense thermal vias; 4 layers / 2oz. Motor outputs: 5A routing.

g.text: Firmware: DAC1_OUT1 PA4 buffer enabled; reference VDDA/VREF+ (+3V3_A).

g.desc: Firmware: DAC1_OUT1 PA4 buffer enabled; reference VDDA/VREF+ (+3V3_A).

g.text: Buffered DAC may retain ~0.2V: ENABLE Low or disable DAC for zero current.

g.desc: Buffered DAC may retain ~0.2V: ENABLE Low or disable DAC for zero current.

g.text: Startup: check VM -> set DAC -> set DMODE -> wait >=7.5us -> ENABLE High.

g.desc: Startup: check VM -> set DAC -> set DMODE -> wait >=7.5us -> ENABLE High.

g.text: Reset: ENABLE/DMODE/AGC Low; evaluate initially with AGC0=AGC1=Low.

g.desc: Reset: ENABLE/DMODE/AGC Low; evaluate initially with AGC0=AGC1=Low.

g.text: CLIM1/BOOST/FLIM pull-ups must use DRV_VCC, never +3V3_D.

g.desc: CLIM1/BOOST/FLIM pull-ups must use DRV_VCC, never +3V3_D.

g.text: Place close to pin35. DRV_VCC: internal 5V, setting circuits only.

g.desc: Place close to pin35. DRV_VCC: internal 5V, setting circuits only.

g.text: VREF: R29=10k series, R30=9.1k to GND, C21=100nF.

g.desc: VREF: R29=10k series, R30=9.1k to GND, C21=100nF.

g.text: R30/C21 GND return near pins29/30, away from OUT/VM.

g.desc: R30/C21 GND return near pins29/30, away from OUT/VM.
